standard_prerequisites.use: Produces the surjective proper morphism of schemes V -> U factoring through Y x_X U.

core_obligations: Let U -> X be affine. Apply weak Chow: there is a surjective proper morphism of schemes V -> U factoring through Y x_X U -> U.
Take a finite affine open cover of V; the induced family {V_k -> U} is a standard ph covering refining {Y x_X U -> U}.
proof_roadmap: Weak Chow factorization over affine charts, then the finite affine refinement.
difficulty_reason: The Chow factorization trick is the substantive step; the refinement assembly is short but real.
